title: orobanche ludoviciana var. genuina
intro: Orobanche ludoviciana var. genuina, commonly known as the "Broomrape", is a parasitic plant that belongs to the Orobanchaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Orobanche ludoviciana var. genuina include anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic effects, which contribute to its use in treating conditions like coughs, colds, and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
